parse.title: Enlightened
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 20.4.1 Fool's Hunt!

Overview

Enlightened is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained via completing Enlightened Portal (guaranteed if you are the host).

Evolving

Enlightened can evolve into Enlightened (Nirvana) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Enlightened
x1 Staff of Realms
x12 Star Fruit
x3 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x3 Star Fruit (Red)
x3 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Enlightened (Nirvana)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
